svg.title: Agentic SOC architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Logical architecture of Agentic SOC in eleven numbered stages. Security sources (SIEM and log stores, EDR and XDR alerts, queues and streams, object stores and files) sit inside an untrusted-data fence. 1 Connectors: three read-only pull connectors (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Wazuh indexer) and sixteen push, queue and object-store receivers. 2 Normalise every record to the OCSF 1.4 event model, keeping provenance; unmapped and raw_data fields stay untrusted. 3 Poll and ingest with a durable cursor per feed, no skip and no duplicate. 4 Deterministic entity correlation, case signatures and a 0 to 100 risk score. 5 Admission gates: the routing risk gate and the budget and cost gate. 6 AI investigation: router, investigator with read-only tools (log query, Redis-cached enrichment, knowledge retrieval, Published runbooks, MITRE ATT&CK context) and formatter; source-derived evidence enters prompts fenced as untrusted data. 7 One model gateway carries every model call to the model providers and writes the usage and cost ledger. 8 The deterministic Case Manager runs decide() against the operator's AutoClosePolicy: close, escalate or needs human; the model only recommends. 9 Cases, collaboration, background jobs and the append-only audit log. 10 The Console and API, Workspace Chat (one engine, read-only tools, metered through the gateway) and analysts. 11 The state store: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Elasticsearch or SQLite.
svg.text: Agentic SOC architecture and data flow
Numbered stages follow one security signal from a source to a reviewed case. Code decides; the model only recommends.
